clauses: This distinguished chemist and university teacher has made significant contributions to the field of chemistry.

In recognition of their outstanding work, they have received numerous prestigious honors, including the Willard Gibbs Award, the National Medal of Science, the Priestley Medal, the Linus Pauling Award, and the Remsen Award.
They were also elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society.
However, despite their highly decorated career, this scientist was never awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
